topic_thesis: Your favorite brands are using 'inflation' as a convenient mask to hike prices by 13% while secretly padding their profit margins at your expense.
strategic_angle: Expose the 'Inflation Smoke Screen' strategy where companies hike prices significantly beyond input cost increases to engineer artificial margin expansion, effectively taxing the consumer to inflate stock valuations.
pinned_comment_text: Are you paying 13% more for the same product while the company reports record profits? Tell us which brand hit your wallet hardest this quarter, or comment 'GUIDE' to learn how to spot 'Shrinkflation' and price-gouging before you buy. 💬👇
tamil_adaptation_directive: Use a tone of 'Kashu mela kashu' (money over money) greed. Use phrases like 'Price hike-nu solli nammala epdi emathuranga' (How they fool us by saying price hike) and 'Company profit-a namma pocket-la irundhu edukuranga' (They take company profit from our pockets). Focus on how the middle-class 'Budget collapse' is actually a planned corporate strategy.
source_signal: Consumer purchasing power erosion & HDFC Securities Q1FY27 Tracker
